Partnership Models

Four models designed for different types of organizations. Choose the one that fits your business — or combine elements from multiple models.

Referral Partner

Introduce us to organizations in your network that need compliance or training support. Earn a referral fee for every successful engagement — no delivery involvement required.

Best For:Consultants, advisors, and professional services firms with broad networks.
Apply for this model

Co-Delivery Partner

Collaborate with Idatum to deliver compliance and training programs to shared clients. We bring the specialist expertise; you bring the client relationship and local presence.

Best For:HR firms, IT services companies, and management consultancies.
Apply for this model

Reseller Partner

License and resell Idatum Academy's course library under your own brand. White-label training content with your organization's identity, backed by Idatum's methodology.

Best For:Training companies, HR technology providers, and LMS operators.
Apply for this model

Technology Partner

Integrate Idatum's compliance assessment tools and training content with your platform, creating bundled solutions that serve your customers' compliance needs.

Best For:GRC platforms, HRIS providers, and compliance technology vendors.
Apply for this model
